description: Defines an enumeration 'GatewayPush' that represents server push messages from a gateway websocket, serving as a modern replacement for 'NotificationCenter'. It includes cases for snapshot, event, and sequence gap messages.

methods.name: GatewayPush.snapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot case with associated HelloOk data.

methods.name: GatewayPush.event
methods.description: Creates an event case with an associated EventFrame.

methods.name: GatewayPush.seqGap
methods.description: Creates a sequence gap case with expected and received sequence numbers.
